scope.description: Manual gap-targeted discovery for Canadian government innovation offices with durable public mandate and operating-program evidence.

source.title: About Innovative Solutions Canada
source.publisher: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
source.locator: Program overview, Challenge Stream, and Testing Stream sections
source.summary: The official ISED page describes Innovative Solutions Canada as an initiative that stimulates Canadian technology research, development, commercialization, and real-world prototype testing through Challenge and Testing streams.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official program overview and department-facing Challenge and Testing Stream guidance
followUpQuestions: Should the public profile represent Innovative Solutions Canada as a government innovation office or as a program operated by ISED?
Which current defence or strategic-technology challenge examples should support the profile without overstating department demand?
What official Ottawa program-office location should be used for the required map coordinates?
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Official ISED pages describe a national program office that helps federal departments define funded challenges, supports Canadian small-business research and prototype development, and arranges real-world testing of pre-commercial innovations.

source.title: How Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security works
source.locator: Program investment, mandate, DND position, and five funding elements
source.summary: The official DND page describes IDEaS as a defence innovation program investing in Canadian concepts, mobilizing innovators through challenges, and building a national defence innovation ecosystem.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official IDEaS mandate, opportunities, funding elements, and annual reporting
followUpQuestions: Should IDEaS receive a separate organization profile when the same identity already exists as a published demand issuer?
Should the profile use government_innovation_office or remain only a program record operated by the Department of National Defence?
What official Ottawa program-office location should be used for the required map coordinates?
leads.organizationName: Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Official DND sources describe a dedicated defence innovation program with competitive projects, innovation networks, contests, sandboxes, test drives, public opportunities, and long-term investment in the Canadian defence innovation ecosystem.

source.title: Defence Research and Development Canada
source.locator: National mandate, partner network, research centres, and innovation programs
source.summary: The official profile identifies DRDC as Canada's defence science, technology, and innovation leader and describes its technical solutions, advice, research centres, and collaboration with government, academia, industry, and allies.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official national profile and partnerships and opportunities page
followUpQuestions: Should DRDC receive a separate organization profile when the same identity already exists as a published demand issuer?
Is research_test_centre a better primary entity kind than government_innovation_office for DRDC's national network?
Should the primary map location be the Ottawa headquarters or should research centres be modeled separately later?
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Official DRDC pages describe a national defence science and technology organization that operates research centres, leads innovation programs, collaborates with industry and academia, transfers technology, and supports DND and CAF capability development.
